stem.en: Two open vessels of very different width are filled with water to the same depth. How do the pressures at their bases compare?
stem.et: Kaks väga erineva laiusega lahtist anumat on täidetud veega sama sügavuseni. Kuidas on rõhud nende põhjas võrreldes?

label.en: They are equal, because pressure depends on depth and density, not on how much liquid there is
label.et: Need on võrdsed, sest rõhk sõltub sügavusest ja tihedusest, mitte vedeliku kogusest

label.en: The wider vessel has the higher pressure, since it holds more water
label.et: Laiemas anumas on suurem rõhk, sest seal on rohkem vett

label.en: The narrow vessel has the lower pressure, because its shape confines the liquid
label.et: Kitsas anumas on väiksem rõhk, sest selle kuju piirab vedelikku

label.en: Neither has pressure at the base, because pressure acts only sideways on the walls
label.et: Kummagi põhjas ei ole rõhku, sest rõhk mõjub ainult külgsuunas seintele
